messages:
laura: quick q — partner wants SIEM export (secure-s3) to include k8s audit + api-gateway traces and retain for 13 months. our pipeline currently exports 90d. does that conflict with our KMS rotation/expiry?

samir: @laura we rotate the CMK every 180d; archived key versions are kept ~7y. the export uses `cmk-siem`. extending retention to 13mo is fine as long as we don't schedule key deletion. deletion would break decryption.

maria: what's the bucket lifecycle today? iirc there's a rule that expires `sec-exports/*` at 90d. we should put partner exports under a new prefix and a 400d lifecycle.

jin: RBAC question — who should have access to that prefix? we must avoid granting broad `analytics-service` role. propose creating `siem-consumer-read-only` with least privilege and timebox the grant. also log reads to audit.

laura: +1. vendor also asked for day-zero streaming (near-real-time). can we stream while keeping per-stream envelope encryption? @kms-bot any constraints?

kms-bot: Notice: envelope encryption supported. recommend `cmk-siem` + per-stream ephemeral DEKs generated via `kms:GenerateDataKey` (Encrypt signed). Ensure the uploader requests DEK at stream start and never persists plaintext keys. See runbook: https://internal/docs/kms/envelope-siem

samir: implementation note: our uploader does multipart uploads and signs manifests. adding envelope flow requires calling KMS per-file (or per-stream start) for a DEK and wrapping the object. i'll prototype a change in the uploader and open a PR.

laura: good. also: update incident runbook — if a CMK compromise occurs we need a clear path to rotate and re-encrypt archives or revoke access. who owns re-encryption?

maria: security will own the plan; infra/storage will own execution. draft playbook steps: - identify affected objects (query prefix) - schedule re-encryption job (decrypt old -> encrypt new per object) - notify partner + defined SLAs - validate integrity + rotate access tokens. i'll add into the runbook.

jin: RBAC change request: add `siem-consumer-read-only` to `analytics-sa` for partner onboarding for 30d. need JIRA + justification. laura can approve short-term grants. also restrict access by vendor IP CIDR.

laura: approved for 30 days, pending JIRA ticket with justification + reviewer (maria). require IP/CIDR restriction on the temporary SA key.

samir: created PR: `github.com/redwood/infra/compare/siem-envelope-encrypt` — includes lifecycle change snippet: 
```
/sec-exports/partner-xyz/* => Lifecycle: NoncurrentVersionExpiration=400d
```

maria: small request: enable bucket access logging for that prefix and forward logs to the forensics pipeline (with PII masking). we need read-audit for partner accesses.

jin: incident checklist add: "unauthorized read -> snapshot affected objects -> revoke SA keys -> rotate CMK -> schedule re-encrypt job -> notify partner + legal". i'll update RUNBOOK_INCIDENT.md.

laura: one more: retention extension (13mo) needs legal sign-off. i've pinged legal and shared the minimization plan. @maria pls coordinate samples if they ask.

maria: on it, i'll prepare a sample redaction/minimization run and timeline. ping me for any dataset examples.

laura: thanks everyone. please post PR link and JIRA id in this thread when created so i can close the loop. :thumbsup:
